Create a rough scatter plot

Source: R/roughViz.R
roughScatter.Rd

Displays points with an optional colour grouping and highlight label.

Usage

roughScatter(
  data,
  x = NULL,
  y = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  colorVar = NULL,
  colors = NULL,
  highlightLabel = NULL,
  roughness = 1,
  fillStyle = "hachure",
  fillWeight = 0.5,
  strokeWidth = 1,
  bowing = 0,
  simplification = 0.2,
  font = 0,
  margin = NULL,
  axisFontSize = "1rem",
  axisRoughness = 0.5,
  axisStrokeWidth = 0.5,
  radius = 8,
  innerStrokeWidth = 1,
  titleAlign = "center",
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A `data.frame` or list containing the x/y coordinates. When passing a data frame you must also provide the column names in `x` and `y`.

x

String naming the column that holds the x values.

y

String naming the column that holds the y values.

title

Optional title placed above the chart.

width

Optional width of the widget (numeric pixels or CSS units).

height

Optional height of the widget (numeric pixels or CSS units).

colorVar

Optional column name indicating a grouping variable used for colouring the points.

colors

Character vector of colours corresponding to the distinct levels in `colorVar`.

highlightLabel

Optional label that should be accentuated using the `highlight` colour.

roughness

Roughness level forwarded to roughViz.js.

fillStyle

Fill style for the points.

fillWeight

Thickness of the fill pattern strokes.

strokeWidth

Outline stroke width for the points.

bowing

Amount of curvature applied to straight segments.

simplification

Simplification tolerance for shapes.

font

Font family reference (`0`, `1`, or custom name).

margin

Named list describing widget margins.

axisFontSize

Font size used for axis labels (CSS units or numbers).

axisRoughness

Roughness setting applied to axes.

axisStrokeWidth

Axis line stroke width.

radius

Circle radius for the points.

innerStrokeWidth

Stroke width used inside points.

titleAlign

Horizontal alignment for the title.

...

Additional named options forwarded to roughViz.js.

Value

A scatter plot `htmlwidget`.

Details

When a data frame is supplied the function verifies that the referenced columns exist, sanitises their types, and reshapes them into the column-based structure that roughViz.js expects (`x`/`y` vectors plus any additional fields such as `colorVar`).

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  roughScatter(
    data = iris,
    x = "Sepal.Length",
    y = "Petal.Length",
    colorVar = "Species",
    title = "Iris measurements",
    radius = 10
  )
}
